caption: Right after the install the app opened on a 7 day trial with no approval screen. A red notice says it is not showing on the store until you turn it on in the theme. The store name is hidden.

We created a recurring event, Harbour Tour Test. The settings warn that the storefront date picker for recurring events is disabled; we left it off, so no booking was tried in the shop. The store name is hidden.
About 2 minutes after the app opened the schedule was saved with one date, Tuesday 24 November at 15:00. We did not set a weekly repeat. The store name is hidden.

Recurring events are struck through on Lite ($0 plus $1.00 per ticket) and listed from Growth ($19 plus $0.75). Mailchimp and Klaviyo are struck through on Lite and Standard. The store name is hidden.
Approving Lite shows no fixed price, only a usage spending limit of up to $50,000 per 30 days. Approve was greyed out next to Add payment method, and we cancelled. The store name is hidden.
